notes.title: MechAvenger is now available!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

MechAvenger is now released! This game has been a large part of my life for the past 2 years and I hope you all enjoy the game. If you have any issues or questions please email me at jonathan@beegangames.com

Thank you,
Jonathan Beegan.

notes.title: Mechavenger release delay
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I am really excited about the upcoming release of MechAvenger, and appreciate all the kind words I have received about the game thus far. However, I sadly must announce that it's release is being delayed, from January 2nd to January 10th. I apologize to anyone looking forward to playing MechAvenger sooner. The game is being delayed for various visibility and marketing reasons related to the new year period. I should have understood these reasons when setting the launch date initially, and I am sorry that I did not. 

I hope you all continue to look forward to playing MechAvenger. In the meantime, please email me at jonathan@beegangames.com if you have any feedback, questions or concerns.

Thanks,
Jonathan Beegan.
